seo.title: TablePro: native database client for {deviceList}
seo.description: TablePro is a native, open-source database client for PostgreSQL, MySQL, SQL Server, MongoDB, Redis and more. Free to use, with optional paid features.

hero.title: A native database client.
hero.subtitle: Run queries, browse and edit data in {featuredEngines} <more>and more</more>.
hero.native: Built with native interfaces, not Electron or a Java runtime.
hero.business: Free to use and open source. Paid plans add features to the {paidPlatformApps}. <pricing>See pricing</pricing>

databases.title: Supported databases
databases.lead: The {macApp} includes common drivers and downloads others when you first use them.
databases.count: Connect to {count} databases on the Mac:
databases.iosSynced: {syncedOnly} connections synced from a Mac open there too.

rows.title: SQL editor
rows.body: Autocomplete suggests tables and columns from your schema. Save queries you reuse and search your query history.

rows.title: Preview your changes
rows.body: Row edits wait until you save. Review the SQL first, or undo changes in the tab.

rows.title: Compare databases
rows.body: Compare schema or data on supported engines and generate a sync script. Review changes that could remove data before including them.

rows.title: Import and export
rows.body: Import {importFormats} files where supported. Export tables or query results as {exportFormats}.

rows.title: Connect to your servers
rows.body: Use SSH tunnels, TLS or supported cloud sign-in methods. Organize saved connections with groups and tags.

safety.title: Safe Mode
body: Set a Safe Mode level for each connection. On the Mac, Alert asks before writes. Safe Mode and Safe Mode (Full) also require Touch ID or your password. Silent is the default. DROP, TRUNCATE and DELETE without WHERE always ask.
On iPhone and iPad, Confirm Writes asks before writes. Read-Only refuses writes on both apps; for MongoDB, Redis and etcd it blocks all commands.

ai.title: AI assistant and MCP
body: Explain or fix SQL with the provider you choose, including a model running locally. Available on the Mac; nothing is sent until you add a provider.
Chat starts in Ask mode. Edit and Agent can run statements, subject to Safe Mode; at Silent, writes can run without approval. Full-window Agent mode uses Alert or stricter.

Connect clients such as {mcpClients} to saved connections through the built-in MCP (Model Context Protocol) server. It listens on {mcpHost}, is off by default and starts with read-only access. Clients never see saved passwords.
Both features are free. Your AI provider may charge for use.

platforms.title: Native apps for {deviceList}
platforms.mac: The desktop app, with separate builds for {architectures}. Includes the SQL editor, schema tools, AI assistant and MCP server.
platforms.ios: Run queries and work with supported tables on {devices}. A separate, free app with SSH tunnels and an optional Face ID lock.
platforms.sync: iCloud Sync shares connections, groups and tags across Apple devices. It is off by default and requires {tier} on the Mac.

switch.title: Bring your connections
switch.lead: Importing from other apps and Open Project Folder are in the {macApp} only.
switch.import: Import connections from {apps}, saved passwords included.
switch.importWithoutPasswords: Connections from {apps} import without their passwords.
switch.project: Open Project Folder creates connections from supported project files, including .env, docker-compose.yml and Prisma schemas.

testimonials.title: What developers say
testimonials.lead: Quoted from public posts, each linked to the original.

pricing.title: Free, Starter and Team
pricing.lead: Use the {macApp} for free, with no trial period. Starter adds {starterExamples}; Team adds {teamExamples}. The {iosApp} is free, with no in-app purchases.

openSource.title: Open source
openSource.body: TablePro is open source under the AGPLv3, including its paid-feature code. Licenses and sponsors fund development.
